craft_notes: Sthāyin: Resting in dependence (nirvṛti). End-dash→comma (mooting softens onto fleeing). Rejected: 'cavil' for 'moot' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: When men moot what uproots all ache — master, 'that thou art' resolved,
who fled not to thee for hold?
l4.sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣakleśahānasya hetuḥ ka iti saṃśaye svāmin so 'sīti niścitya kas tvāṃ na śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

reads_against.argmap: Of abandoning all suffering the cause who — when in such doubt. → Deciding 'he you are', all take refuge; none has not.
reads_against.l2: When men doubt what uproots all ache — master, resolved 'that art thou' — who has failed to flee to you?
l3: When men moot what uproots all ache — master, 'that thou art' resolved —
who fled not to thee for hold?
reads_against.t1: Of abandoning all suffering the cause who — when in such doubt — O master, 'he you are' having decided — who has not gone to you as refuge?
